title: Halo Combat Evolved.iso
queue_order: Queued by the lane (an env pair; arms.sh skips a_ref == b_ref): two requests of one run each, A then B (leg R): TITLE_ROUTES=docs/lanes/halo1016/routes request.sh --who halo1016 --device nova --title 'Halo Combat Evolved.iso' --route halo-cinematic --seconds 420 --ref 8f70b1e9e0 --env ... --issue 938 --expect this file. 8f70b1e9e0 is the lane head: master's emulator plus the off-by-default HAKUX_APU_METER meter and HAKUX_APU_HRTF_NORM switch (hw/xbox/mcpx/apu/vp/vp.c, hrtf.h). From boot, not from the owner's slot0.hxs: a dispatcher soak does not load a state (disk-snapshot-missing, NOTES.md), and a state does not carry the HRIRs (vp.hrtf.entries is not in the vmstate), so a 3D A/B from a state would run the bed through stale taps.
judge: python3 docs/lanes/halo1016/speechread.py --expect docs/testing/predictions/halo1016-speech.json A=<A result> R=<B result> (written before either result is read; it prints every speech window's levels, the 2D voice table and each 3D voice's HRIR scale whatever the verdict). A re-read with --speech/--music naming the voices from the A leg's 2D voice table is allowed if the from-boot run allocates the dialogue or music to other voice indices than the owner's session did (v65; v85/v86/v88); the thresholds do not change.
baseline: Offline, from the owner's slot0/1/2 states (docs/lanes/halo1016/scratch/audio/REPORT.md 1.2): MON_VP plays the dialogue v65 (2D mono, bins 0/1 at -13.4 dB) +4.1 dB over the 2D music at slot0 and +1.0 at slot1, exactly the title's volume-register ratio. The rest of the mix is a 3D bed of low-frequency voices (v4/v5/v6 one buffer at 136 Hz; v15 at slot2, -18.3 dBFS before the HRTF, 12 dB over everything) through the HRTF with taps divided by their L1 sum (hrtf.h). The HRIRs are not in a state, so the bed's level after the HRTF has never been measured; offline figures are upper bounds (|H| <= 1 under L1).
prediction: #938: is the bed's level after the HRTF the reason the dialogue sounds buried, and does the HRIR scale move it. H2 (P 0.30): the mix is the title's own; speech over music matches the registers. H1 (P 0.20): the L1 division plays the bed louder than the taps as the guest sent them. H3 (P 0.12): the dialogue stream starves in the slow shots (#1018). Predicted: B: A's median speech-over-music (S-M) over speech windows is >= 0 dB (point +2). L: the median raw l1 over A's 3D HRIR binds is < 1.0 (P 0.35; if it is >= 1, raw makes the bed LOUDER and H1 in this direction is refuted: that is a miss, read as such). N: R's median 3d level is >= 3 dB under A's and R's median speech-over-rest (S-R) >= 3 dB over A's, with no more clipping (P 0.20). S: A logs >= 1 `apuvoice sslempty v=65` after mark cinematic (P 0.12). What refutes H1: L misses, or N misses with the bed within 1 dB across A and R. What refutes H2: B misses (speech under music in hakuX against registers that put it over). Leg D (HAKUX_APU_USE_DSP=1) is not run: the offline dsp_harness already ran Halo's own GP/EP program (REPORT.md 1.3), which puts the bed +4.65 dB further over speech, and the VP's HRTF scale is upstream of the DSP, so D cannot tell H1 from H2.
expect_note: EMPTY of captures ON PURPOSE: a soak writes none. Named rules read by docs/lanes/halo1016/speechread.py --expect (legs V, B, L, N, S; U only with an H leg). V on both legs: route-frames booted/profile/level/difficulty/loading read by eye; `mark cinematic`; `apu_meter: on`; `hrtf_norm: l1 (default)` on A and `hrtf_norm: raw` on R; >= 8 meter windows with the dialogue voice in top=; the music voices in at least half of them. A run whose route did not reach LOADING is void, not a miss.
